credit_metrics.text: EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}} on revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2025}}, and operating profit increased by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}} as depreciation fell by {{dda.change@FY2025}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments were broadly unchanged at {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and total liquidity stood at {{liquidity@FY2025}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} of undrawn committed facilities.
Liquidity to revenue was {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, while cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}.
